title: WE PRAISE THEE, O GOD, OUR REDEEMER
author: Julia B. Cory
stanzas: We praise Thee, O God, our Redeemer, Creator, In grateful devotion our tribute we bring; We lay it before Thee, we kneel and adore Thee, We bless Thy holy Name, glad praises we sing

We worship Thee, God of our fathers, We bless Thee; Through life's storm and tempest our guide have Thou been; When perils overtake us, escape Thou will make us, And with Thy help, O Lord, our battles we win
With voices united our praises we offer, To Thee, great Jehova, glad anthems we raise. Thy strong arm will guide us, our God is beside us, To Thee, our great Redeemer, forever be praise.
